title: デビュー戦の後に・レースって最高！

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yoo-hoo! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yeah, it was great!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It felt like I shifted into a higher gear than what I've done in pair running and scrimmage races!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: It makes me so happy to think that every time I race, I'll be able to feel this way! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, now that I've made my debut, what's our next goal?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer, now that I've made my debut, what's our next goal?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: We might as well aim for the biggest race, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The "biggest race" she's talking about must be the one to decide the junior champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her ability, she can definitely run there. I really want to see her take it all the way—making our next goal…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's what I was hoping you'd say!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I'm absitively posolutely ready for that race! Let's go for it full throttle!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, Maruzensky sets her sights on her next big race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The following day…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All righty, time for some hardcore training!
choice_data_list: Don't you think you should rest the day after a race?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: As if! I've set my sights on a G1, so I have to buckle down!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Maruzensky! Sorry to bother you, but could I ask you a few questions?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Your fans have been calling you "Hot Rod" since before your debut! What are your feelings on the nickname now?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'd love to chat, but I have to get to my training!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I know! If you can catch me, I'll give you a special scoop! Ready? Go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: H-how the heck are we supposed to catch a running Umamusume?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Let's surround her! Come at her from the other side!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky proceeds to lead the reporters on a chase, having a blast all the while.
